Submitted (ok:true), status locked as **deviation**.

What changed in this pass to cure the intent failure:

- The residual second sentence of § 14.2 no longer contradicts our ownership: a one-word party flip makes the revocable, non-transferable, term-limited licence run **to Vendor** ("Vendor receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term"), removing the dangling mechanic under which Vendor could revoke or time-limit our use of our own Deliverables.
- Ownership flip and assignment retained unchanged (operator flip in sentence 1 plus one concise assignment sentence).
- Deletion of the sentence was attempted first but the official gate blocks whole-sentence deletion (1.000 ratio) and whole-paragraph deletion, so the party-direction flip is the smallest compliant cure; all other language in 14.1, 14.3 and 14.4 is byte-for-byte untouched, and no fallback-level licence terms were imported.
